description.value:
An animal companion's abilities are determined by the druid's level and its animal racial traits. They remain creatures of the animal type for purposes of determining which spells can affect them.

Animal Skills

Animal companions can have ranks in any of the following skills:

  • Acrobatics* (Dex)
  • Climb* (Str)
  • Escape Artist (Dex)
  • Fly* (Dex)
  • Intimidate (Cha)
  • Perception* (Wis)
  • Stealth* (Dex)
  • Survival (Wis)
  • Swim* (Str)

All of the skills marked with an (*) are class skills for animal companions. Animal companions with an Intelligence of 3 or higher can put ranks into any skill.

candidates.rationale: pf-companion-features-507-improved-evasion-level: the CRB animal companion body (pp. 51-53) is supported by PCGen's Core Rulebook companion rows (abilities by druid level, the animal type, the nine animal skills and six class skills, BAB and saves, the Hit Dice schedule and every feature level but one), but its schedule grants Improved Evasion at effective druid level 15 where PCGen's Core Rulebook schedule says 16, which no permitted source decides. Its classAssociations name the eleven features as inert game content, not content references, so its bound closure is the record alone and needs no further notice. Existing reviewed CRB notice covers it. Statistics are calculated by the companion progression (#325).

This resource supplies the rules text only.
companionReview.classSchedules716: #716 P7a models the master classes' companion-granting features (Druid Nature Bond as an option, the Hunter's Animal Companion and its own Bonus Tricks, pf1/VNAsksfmUCMQsoZE), not the animal companion's own features; no feature is curated twice.

prerequisiteReview.review: A companion feature resource has no selection prerequisite. Its effective druid level is an animal companion progression fact (companionReview.masterLevel), not a prerequisite atom.

proficiencyReview.review: No weapon or armor proficiency grant in this body.

outstandingCalculations: The animal companion's statistics (Hit Dice, BAB, saves, natural armor, Str/Dex bonus, bonus tricks, feat, skill and ability-increase budgets) are calculated by the companion progression (#325), not by this resource; its class fields stay inert.
Species statistics beyond the representative wolf and horse, and archetype or class-specific companion rules, are outside this record.
mechanicsReview.proseOnlyRules: The animal type for spells and the Intelligence 3 skill rule stay readable prose.
sourceDiscrepancies: Improved Evasion's threshold disagrees between the sources: the pinned body ("If your effective druid level is at least 15") and the Animal Companion record's classAssociations give effective druid level 15, while PCGen's Core Rulebook schedule (data/pathfinder/paizo/roleplaying_game/core_rulebook/cr_abilities_companion.lst:46) grants it at PREVARGTEQ:MasterLevel,16. No PRD page or book PDF is available to decide it.

skillsPerLevel 1 is Foundry's per-level skill rank field; PCGen gives max(1, 2 + Int modifier) per Hit Die. Both give 1 for the Intelligence 1-2 of the CRB animals; the progression (#325) budgets ranks itself. Recorded.

candidates.rationale: pf-companion-features-507-whole-content-w8QhU9qZ4VXxO4Ij: the body's feat list is a compilation, not the Core Rulebook list. Of PCGen's 29 Core Rulebook animal companion feats it omits Improved Natural Attack and Weapon Finesse, and it adds 15 pf1-content feats (Devotion against the Unnatural, Disruptive Companion, Feral Grace, Ferocious Beast, Ferocious Feint, Friendly Face, Greater Tenacious Hunter, Hefty Brute, Improved Intercept Blow, Intercept Blow, Linnorm Hunter Style, Linnorm Hunter Retreat, Reflexive Interception, Share Feature, Tenacious Hunter) whose records cite no source, so their books and notices are unresolved. The body also links Improved Natural Armor as pf-content.pf-feats.n1wLrcwaqOSDqrOo, where no record exists (the pf1 feats pack has it), so the gate fails the entry as a broken reference (pf-companion-features-507-broken-reference-w8QhU9qZ4VXxO4Ij). The CRB framing sentences (the base attack bonus +1 limit until 3 Hit Dice, Intelligence 3 or higher, GM expansion) are supported. Its bound closure carries Unchained action costs (the linked Spring Attack and Combat Reflexes), so the held Pathfinder Unchained notice (PZO1131) is required too. Existing reviewed CRB notice covers the CRB part.
